notes: Municipal zoning districts of towns in Moore County, published by Moore County GIS on its public ArcGIS Online organization (MoorePublic_AGO, layer City Zoning). jurisdiction holds coded town abbreviations (AB, CA, CG, FF, PB, PH, RB, SP, TT, VA, WP, CN) as the layer gives them; LABEL combines code and district. Unincorporated county zoning is in a separate layer (MoorePublic_AGO layer Zoning, ZCODE), which fails the polygon-validity check.
